message.content: {"rules":["The closure passed to `before_exec`, when run in the child process after `fork` and before `exec`, must perform only async-signal-safe operations.","The closure passed to `before_exec`, when run in the child process after `fork`, must not violate library invariants through invalid use of resources duplicated by `fork`, including file descriptors and memory-mapped regions.","Panicking in the closure passed to `before_exec` is safe only if all format arguments for the panic message can be safely formatted, even though `Command` calls `std::panic::always_abort` before invoking the closure."]}
